newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Local group buys Brazil Ferroeste rail concession.
newsitem.headline: Local group buys Brazil Ferroeste rail concession.

text.p: A consortium led by Brazilian group MPE acquired for the base price of 25.7 million reais a 30-year concession to operate cargo services of the Ferroeste railway, the Parana bourse said.

The Ferrovia Oeste do Parana (Ferroeste) railway links the cities of Cascavel and Guarapuava in Parana state and is connected to the South section of Brazil's federal railway network, due to be privatized this month.
The auction had been previously slated for December 4, but was postponed until today after an injunction blocking the sale was lifted.
The auction was held on the Parana Stock Exchange.
